name: Herzstück
kurzbeschreibung:
**Heart of the Alps in Zams** --- **

Welcome to Zams – Where Tradition Meets Adventure

** Nestled in the breathtaking **Tirol** Alps, **Zams** is a charming village that perfectly blends rustic tradition with thrilling outdoor experiences. Whether you're seeking relaxation in the heart of nature or an adrenaline rush on the slopes, **Zams** promises unforgettable moments for every traveler. --- **

Explore the Beauty of the Alps

** Discover the stunning landscapes of **Zams** on foot, by bike, or with a guided tour. The village is surrounded by pristine meadows, dense forests, and towering peaks, offering endless opportunities for hiking, mountain biking, and wildlife spotting. Don’t miss the chance to visit the **Zams Wildpark**, where you can observe native alpine animals up close. For those who love panoramic views, the **Zamsalm** hike leads you to a breathtaking viewpoint overlooking the entire valley. The trail is suitable for all fitness levels, making it a perfect activity for families and nature enthusiasts alike. --- **

Winter Wonderland: Skiing & Snowboarding

** When winter arrives, **Zams** transforms into a paradise for winter sports lovers. As part of the **Skigebiet Silvretta Arena**, the village offers over **120 km of perfectly groomed slopes**, catering to beginners and experts alike. The **Zams ski area** is especially family-friendly, with gentle runs and a cozy **Hütten** (mountain hut) atmosphere. After a day on the slopes, warm up in one of the village’s traditional **Gasthöfe** (inns), where hearty dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Tiroler Gröstl**, or a steaming bowl of **Käsespätzle** await you. Pair your meal with a glass of local **Apfelstrudel** (apple strudel) or a cold **Tiroler Bier** for the ultimate alpine experience. For night owls, the **Zams Night Skiing** events bring the slopes to life after dark, complete with festive music and illuminated trails. --- **

Summer Delights: Hiking, Lakes & Culture

** Summer in **Zams** is all about exploring the great outdoors. Take a refreshing dip in the crystal-clear waters of **Silvretta Lake** or **Zamssee**, surrounded by the dramatic beauty of the **Silvretta Mountains**. The **Alpsee Trail** offers a scenic lakeside walk with stunning reflections of the peaks. Culture lovers will appreciate the **Zams Church**, a historic landmark with beautiful frescoes, or the **Almwirtschaften** (mountain dairy farms), where you can sample fresh **Käse** (cheese), **Butter** (butter), and **Speck** (smoked bacon) straight from the farm. Don’t forget to try **Tiroler Spezialitäten** like **Schlutzkrapfen** (stuffed pasta) or **Leberknödel** (liver dumplings) at one of the village’s cozy restaurants. --- **

Family Fun in Zams

** **Zams** is a haven for families, with plenty of activities to keep both kids and adults entertained. The **Zams Adventure Park** offers a **Kletterwald** (high ropes course) and a **Mini-Golf** course, while the **Zams Wildpark** provides a fun and educational experience for young explorers. In winter, the **Zams Rodelbahn** (sleigh ride) is a hit with children, offering a thrilling (but safe) descent through the snowy landscape. For younger kids, the **Zams Kinderspielplatz** (playground) is the perfect spot for a break. --- **

Getting There & Staying

** **Zams** is easily accessible by car or public transport. The village is just a **30-minute drive from Innsbruck**, making it an ideal day trip or weekend getaway. For those arriving by train, the nearest station is **Landeck-Zams**, with regular connections from **Innsbruck**. When it comes to accommodation, **Zams** offers a range of options, from luxury **Almhotels** (mountain hotels) with stunning views to cozy **Ferienwohnungen** (holiday apartments) and rustic **Berghütten** (mountain huts). Many lodgings also feature **Sauna** and **Wellness** facilities, perfect for relaxing after a day of adventure. --- **

Plan Your Visit to Zams

** Whether you're here for the **ski season**, the **summer hikes**, or simply to soak in the alpine charm, **Zams** promises an authentic **Tirol** experience. Visit the official [Zams Tourism website](https://www.zams.at) for the latest updates on events, lifts, and activities. **

Come and discover why Zams is the heart of the Alps!

**
